verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships its own inference engines and a hosted cloud inference API, so serving-architecture optimizations are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence mentions separating prefill and decode phases or any large-scale serving architecture. The hosted Wally docs cover only an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and running models on RunAnywhere's hardware.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
